companies.name: 4baseCare
companies.description: Precision oncology platform leveraging whole-exome sequencing and clinical datasets from underrepresented Indian populations. ICMR-collaborated pipeline targeting colorectal, lung, and breast cancer subtypes absent from Western cohorts. Clinico-genomic reports in clinical use at leading Indian cancer centres.

companies.name: Perceptyne
companies.description: Full-stack humanoid and dextrous robot systems. PR-9D single-arm (9-DoF) and PR-34D dual-arm (34-DoF) platforms with proprietary tactile-sensing hardware trained on in-house manipulation datasets. Targeting automotive, electronics, and precision assembly lines.

companies.name: C2i Semiconductors
companies.description: Digital power management ICs for AI data center infrastructure. Proprietary controllers delivering 40% efficiency improvement over analog alternatives, reducing total rack power consumption. First silicon in production; Series A co-led by Yali with anchor institutional LP participation.

companies.name: Tonbo Imaging
companies.description: AI-powered electro-optical and infrared sensor systems for defence and ISR. Export-qualified product line deployed with the Indian Army and global OEM customers. Active Series D follow-on in process; expanding IP base into high-power microwave directed energy applications.

companies.name: PointAI
companies.description: GenAI-powered spatial commerce platform enabling customers to visualise and interact with physical products in 3D before purchase. Integrates with existing e-commerce product catalogues; deployment active with consumer electronics and furniture retailers. Reduces returns rate and increases conversion on high-consideration purchases.

companies.name: LatentForce
companies.description: Enterprise code modernisation using AI and automation. Platform analyses legacy codebases (COBOL, Fortran, Java EE) and generates modernised equivalents with automated test coverage and regression validation. Series A fundraise in progress. Target customers: large financial institutions and public-sector IT departments.

companies.name: DeepLase
companies.description: IIT-Delhi spin-out with proprietary fiber laser and photonics IP developed over eight years. Applications span directed energy weapons, industrial precision cutting, and free-space optical (FSO) secure communications. iDEX-funded prototype delivered to DRDO; strategic interest from Indian defence primes and allied government labs.
